guide.welcomeButton: Connect Golan to your browser now
guide.title: Connect Golan to your browser
guide.heading: Add Golan to your browser
guide.subtitle: Pick the browser and the profile; Golan checks every step for you.
guide.noBrowsers: No supported browser was found on this PC (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox…).
guide.step1: Open the extensions page in this profile (the extension path is copied for you).
guide.step2: Turn on “Developer mode” with the switch at the top of the extensions page.
guide.step3: Click “Load unpacked”, paste the path with Ctrl+V into the address bar at the top of the window, press Enter, then “Select Folder”.
guide.opened: The browser was opened on its extensions page; the path is copied and ready to paste.
guide.openFailed: The browser could not be opened automatically. Open it yourself and type the address.
guide.clipboardFailed: Could not copy. Copy the path from the box yourself.
guide.fallback: If the extensions page did not open, type this in the browser's address bar: {0}
guide.ext.installed: Golan's extension is installed in this profile
guide.ext.missing: Golan's extension is not installed in this profile yet
guide.ext.disabled: Golan's extension is installed but turned off — turn it on in the extensions page
guide.summary.done: ✓ Golan is connected to this profile and ready to catch downloads.
guide.summary.installed: ✓ The extension is installed. Golan will connect in a moment; if not, restart the browser.
guide.summary.disabled: The extension is installed but turned off. Switch it on in the extensions page.
guide.summary.devOff: Start by opening the extensions page and turning on “Developer mode”.
guide.summary.load: Developer mode is on ✓ — now load the extension (step 3).
guide.ff.heading: Firefox
guide.ff.note: Regular Firefox only keeps add-ons signed by Mozilla, so Golan's add-on is loaded temporarily until Firefox closes, until it is published on Mozilla's store.
guide.ff.step1: Open Firefox's “Debugging” page (the add-on file path is copied for you).
guide.ff.step2: Click “Load Temporary Add-on…”, paste the path with Ctrl+V and pick the file:
guide.ff.address: If the page did not open, type in the address bar: about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox
guide.honest: Chrome and Edge do not let any program install an extension by itself, to protect you, so two clicks remain. Once Golan is on the Chrome Web Store it becomes a one-click install.
